item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed, leaning negative. Jokowi kept at least one highly credible economic technocrat at the core of government, but the 2024 reshuffle also placed Prabowo-aligned loyalists and political-business figures into key economic posts. The public record shows competence at the macro level, but not a clean technocratic staffing pattern.

**Accepted Claims**

- **Indonesia Economy Projected to Remain Resilient** — World Bank, 2024-06-24, https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient  
  Claim: The World Bank said Indonesia’s solid macro framework helped attract investment and that continued prudent, credible, transparent policy was needed to sustain broad-based growth. This supports a positive reading that Jokowi’s economic team was technocratic and policy-oriented rather than purely loyalist-driven.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, also `5B.1`

- **Analysis-Indonesian markets rattled by election uncertainty, Finance Minister's future** — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-02-01, https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisindonesian-markets-rattled-by-election-uncertainty-finance-ministers-future-3289355  
  Claim: Reuters described Sri Mulyani as a highly regarded finance minister whose possible departure worried markets, and said her ministry kept working normally. That is positive evidence that Jokowi had installed and retained a competent economic professional with real standing.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, also `5B.1`

- **In the Trenches: Relentless Reformer** — IMF, 2024-12, https://www.imf.org/en/publications/fandd/issues/2024/12/trenches-relentless-reformer-sri-mulyani-indrawati  
  Claim: The IMF profile says Sri Mulyani, after returning as Jokowi’s finance minister, strengthened macro foundations, broadened the tax base, capped subsidies, and enforced high standards. This is strong positive evidence that Jokowi empowered a competent economic professional rather than a mere loyalist.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, also `5B.1`

- **Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo** — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-19, https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/  
  Claim: Jokowi appointed people close to Prabowo into energy, investment, and related roles, including Bahlil Lahadalia, Rosan Roeslani, and Dadan Hindayana. Reuters framed the reshuffle as transition-smoothing and noted most appointees were close to Prabowo, which is negative evidence for a pure meritocracy.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, also `4B.8`

- **Private Power and Public Office: The Rise of Business Politicians in Indonesia** — Taylor & Francis, 2024, https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/14672715.2024.2334069  
  Claim: The paper says Jokowi stood out for preferring non-party businesspeople in cabinet, and that ministers often brought in private-sector allies and staff. That supports a negative reading: cabinet staffing leaned toward business-political networks, not only neutral technocrats.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, also `5B.1`

- **Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s democracy icon, leaves illiberal legacy, critics say** — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14, https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/  
  Claim: Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left behind patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. While broader than economic staffing, it is negative background evidence that his governing style relied on political loyalty and network preservation rather than purely professional statecraft.  
  IDs: `5B.2`, also `4B.10`

**Search Gap**
- I found limited direct evidence on day-to-day empowerment inside the economic ministries. The public record is mostly indirect: cabinet names, market reactions, and performance outcomes. I did not find strong sourced evidence in 2024 of Jokowi putting family members into core economic posts, but I also did not find evidence that key economic decisions were insulated from political loyalty or transition bargaining.
